preliminary_proposals.1: And they took me into one place, where those who were there were like burning fire; and when they wished, they showed themselves like human beings.
preliminary_proposals.2: And they took me to a place of tempest, and to a mountain whose highest summit reaches heaven.

preliminary_proposals.5: And I came to a river of fire, whose fire flows like water and pours into a great sea toward the west.
